name: denubis-hook-question-zone
description: Once Codex shows a native question, search in the background for an answer the person already gave.

interface.shortDescription: Find earlier answers to questions Codex shows
interface.longDescription: After Codex shows a native question, a fresh Terra reader searches decision records and chats in the background; an earlier answer whose quote checks out reaches the asking session as context. Codex owns the question UI.
defaultPrompt: Look for an answer I already gave to each question you ask me.
